title: Stairway to Fallen Angels
description: A woman in a flowing dark gown ascends a grand stone staircase while holding chains, looking up toward a large classical painting on the wall depicting falling angels and dramatic clouds. The flooded lower level contains submerged furniture, a broken picture frame, red velvet chairs, and glowing candelabras underwater beneath a glass ceiling with dramatic spotlight beams cutting through the dark interior.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene inside a decaying grand hall with a glass ceiling. A woman in a flowing dark burgundy gown ascends a wide stone staircase carrying chains, gazing up at a massive classical painting on the wall showing angels falling from heaven. The lower floor is completely flooded with dark water containing submerged red velvet furniture, broken picture frames, and glowing candelabras. Dramatic spotlight beams shine down from above, cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere.
